containment.campaign_holds: an ordered set of rounds implementing an explicit set of accepted decision records
containment.round_holds: the smallest set of waves that can close with one attestation decision and one merged head
containment.wave_holds: one coupled task group: exactly one architect, one inspector, and one engineer task in pipeline order, or one single-role task
containment.task_holds: one role, one session, one branch, one pull request, one boundary
containment.cross_round_dependency: forbidden-between-waves-and-tasks; only rounds depend on rounds
containment.record_coverage: every record listed on the campaign appears on at least one round and every round record appears on at least one of its waves
containment.runtime_state: this document is a plan and ledger; runtime state lives in governed round and task records

identity.allocation: round ids are allocated from the campaign number times one hundred plus the round ordinal; wave and task ids are allocated from .devai/state/counters.json when materialized and may be pre-allocated in the plan
identity.collision_with_governed_records: a plan id that already exists under work/rounds or .devai/state/tasks is a load error

ordering.rounds: depends_on-partial-order; a round opens only when every round it depends on is closed
ordering.merge_order: architect, inspector, engineer; each downstream branch rebases after the upstream merge
ordering.branch_creation: architect from integration head; inspector from architect head; engineer from inspector head

transitions.when: the mandate holder approves the plan, or withdraws it
the first round opens, or the mandate is withdrawn
every round is closed, or the mandate is withdrawn with at least one round not closed
the round open gate holds, or the campaign is abandoned
every task in every wave is merged or cancelled with at least one merged, or the campaign is abandoned
the round close gate holds, or a close check fails and a task is reopened to correct it
its round is open and every wave it depends on is merged and no open wave shares a lock scope, or the round is abandoned
its last task in pipeline order is merged, or the round is abandoned
its wave is open and its upstream task is merged or it has no upstream, or the wave is cancelled
a human opens a session with the task discipline declared and the prompt sha256 is pinned
the session emits a checkpoint, opens the pull request with acceptance commands passing, reports a gap that needs another role, or is withdrawn
work resumes, the pull request is opened, or a gap is reported

the pull-request gate is green, under review.mode model-advisory the task carries a recorded review block whose verdict validates and whose reply digest matches, and a human ratifies and merges; or review requests a change
the gap is resolved by the responsible role, or the task is withdrawn

round_open: every record on the round has status accepted
every round in depends_on is closed
every task boundary path is inside the constitution authority row of its discipline
wave_open: every wave in depends_on is merged
no open wave in the round shares a lock scope prefix
task_start: the upstream task is merged or the task is the architect position
the prompt file sha256 is recorded on the task
the session role equals the task discipline
the tier map is resolved from law/policy/model-tiers.json merged with the campaign models override and pinned on the task as execution.resolved with the default policy_version
task_pre_merge: every acceptance command exits zero on the branch head
every wave gate check member passes on the branch head
every commit on the branch satisfies the commit rules below
the diff touches only boundary paths
under serialized admission, no other pull request targeting the integration branch is in pre_merge
under review.mode model-advisory, the advisory verdict, the SHA-256 of the reply it was extracted from, the evaluator, and the time are recorded on the task before the human ratifies
round_close: every task is merged or cancelled
the universal close checks and the round close_checks pass on the merged head

every Owner effect in owner_effects_required carries performed_at, with either outcome: performed, the default when outcome is absent, or fallback, when the effect was resolved by the fallback its description names and performed_at records when that fallback was recorded; an effect whose required_before names the round and lacks performed_at is owner-effect-not-performed and the round cannot close
when attestation_reissue is true, the new task-policy digest is recorded in closure and the attestation is re-issued for it before any release plan uses the head

model_evaluation.where: inside the human-initiated orchestrator session, by a model instance distinct from the working agent of the task (law/constitution.md Article 18)
model_evaluation.output: an advisory verdict in the shape law/schemas/review-verdict.schema.json (ADR-MDL-0001) declares

gate_ratification.where: the ratifying human reads the advisory verdict, when one exists, and records the gate

merge.where: the integration effect of law/constitution.md Article 28; a human role under ADR-GOV-0002

dispatch.where: every remote effect is human, exact, and single-use as ADR-GOV-0012 and the authorization ledger require

modes.human: the default when review.mode is absent; no step is delegated and no task carries a review block
modes.model-advisory: model_evaluation is delegated; the other three steps are unchanged; the campaign declares it in review.mode and every task in pre_merge carries the review block before the human ratifies

review.recording_rule: under model-advisory the orchestrator records on the task, before the human ratifies the gate, the verdict document, the SHA-256 digest of the reply it was extracted from, the evaluator in the runtime:model form, and the time; a task in pre_merge whose review block is missing, whose verdict fails the verdict schema, or whose digest does not match the recorded reply cannot transition to merged, and the checker names the task
review.advisory_only: a model verdict is advice to the ratifying human and to no one else; it never satisfies a gate, triggers a merge, or authorizes an effect; a review verdict is routed through the law/constitution.md Article 23 ladder by the human who ratifies; the ledger shows a human actor on the gate, the merge, and every remote effect
review.session: a verdict produced outside a human-initiated orchestrator session is refused

tier_resolution.default: law/policy/model-tiers.json, validated by law/schemas/model-tiers.schema.json; law that changes only through a law commit that bumps its policy_version
tier_resolution.override: a campaign models block overrides the default by tier name only; a tier it does not name resolves to the default; a campaign never introduces a host
tier_resolution.fail_closed: an unknown tier name is unknown-tier, an effort outside the tier grammar is effort-outside-tier-grammar, a host the default does not declare is unknown-host, and an alias the host does not declare is unknown-model-alias; each fails closed at the campaign check
tier_resolution.pin: the merged map is pinned on the task at task_start as execution.resolved, every entry in the runtime:model registry id form, with the default policy_version; a task that starts without the pin is resolution-not-pinned
tier_resolution.immutability: a later change to the default or to the override never reinterprets a started task; a task started before the change keeps its pinned map and policy_version, and only a task started after resolves the new default
tier_resolution.escalation: law/constitution.md Article 19 escalation climbs the pinned map, one rank up to its ceiling
tier_resolution.registry: every host alias the default names resolves through law/policy/model-runtime-registry.json by the runtime id the host declares; a default naming a runtime the registry does not declare, or a family that does not match, fails the law check
tier_resolution.closed_campaigns: a closed campaign keeps its own models block byte-for-byte as evidence and validates unchanged because the block remains admitted

gates.gate_evaluation: a human evaluates and records; no gate is inferred from a green check alone, and none from a model verdict

isolation.worktree: one dedicated worktree per task; never the root checkout
isolation.base: architect from the integration branch head; downstream positions from the upstream branch head, rebased after each upstream merge
isolation.merge_method: rebase; squash is forbidden because it recombines single-family commits, and a merge commit is excluded by linear history on the integration branch; rebase is the only method under which the commits the integration gate tests are the commits that reach the integration branch
isolation.pull_request_cardinality: one-per-task, or one-per-wave when one orchestrator runs the wave's tasks in pipeline order as separate role-declared sessions on one branch; commits stay single-family and role-attributed either way
isolation.integration_boundaries: two: the local preflight against a named fetched base is the ready-for-a-pull-request condition, repeated by the pull_request run of the gate on the head; integration validation runs against the queue candidate under merge_group, measured against the queue base, and that run is the one binding for the integration branch
isolation.queue_admission: a pull request enters the merge queue when its own required gate is green on its head; the queue rebases the entry onto the current tip of the integration branch and re-runs the gate on the rebased candidate with the queue base as its base; an entry whose gate fails is evicted with its diagnostic, its task returns from pre_merge to in_progress, and no entry behind it is cancelled; a red head is never admitted and a stale candidate is never retried
isolation.queue_prerequisite: the merge queue merges with the rebase method together with linear history and the single required check; enabling it is an Owner effect on the repository settings, verified and performed before the round that delivers the merge_group lane closes; when the prerequisite fails, the Owner records the serialized-admission fallback on that effect with outcome fallback and performed_at set to the time of the recording, which lets the round close without enabling the queue; allow_update_branch is a convenience, not a prerequisite
isolation.serialized_admission: in force whenever the merge queue is not enabled on the integration branch: that is, whenever the merge-queue Owner effect has no performed_at, or carries performed_at with outcome fallback because the prerequisite failed and the fallback was recorded in its place; only performed_at with outcome performed, or with no outcome, lifts it; while in force, at most one pull request targeting the integration branch is in pre_merge at a time; a second task does not enter pre_merge until that pull request is merged or returned to in_progress, and once it merges the next task rebases onto the new tip and re-runs the local preflight before opening its pull request

CMP-0006.bookkeeping_rule: source checkpoints and draft accounting are not runtime records; post-merge final effects/observations close rounds only when universal and issue-specific gates hold; no third implementation PR inferred
CMP-0006.expiry: CMP-0006 closed or abandoned; no override for other source campaigns or adopters
CMP-0006.source_lock_rule: acquire the complete declared wave lock set before writing; release at a frozen reviewed checkpoint and exact handoff; serialize every overlapping scope; a previously completed unmerged contribution is read-only unless reopened and re-reviewed
CMP-0006.post_merge_phase_rule: R-0608 source work requires actual R-0607 closure and immutable publication; R-0609 candidate accounting may be prepared from the reviewed R-0608 checkpoint but final observations/closure wait for actual R-0608 integration, closure and effects

standing_owner_authority.scope: routine proposals, exact scoped plan amendments, role-bounded implementation and tests, local commits, source checkpoint acceptance, coordination, integration and necessary declared campaign completion effects
standing_owner_authority.acceptance: automatic after exact-candidate evidence and distinct qualified review; acceptance is exercised under standing human mandate, never represented as a new human review
standing_owner_authority.exceptions: substantive unresolved product/risk decisions, unavailable credentials/protected approvals, failed technical gates and externally required independent confirmations remain explicit
standing_owner_authority.expiry: CMP-0006 closed or abandoned; never another campaign or adopter

execution_discipline.agent_count: inclusive of Architect coordinator, task workers, reviewers and nested agents; slots are not multiplicative
execution_discipline.dispatch: central campaign coordinator alone grants round permit after predecessor and capacity verification; queued chats acknowledge then stay idle without source writes or workers
execution_discipline.coordination: Owner explicitly authorizes messages among central campaign chat and its eight round chats; no unsolicited third-party messaging
execution_discipline.handoff: exact immutable source checkpoint, complete wave locks, no shared mutable worktree; parent-child pipeline order retained

concurrency_amendment.task_limit_meaning: maximum concurrent task/agent slots; inclusive coordinator, workers, reviewers and nested agents, not total planned task count
concurrency_amendment.transition: central enters the later phase when the first eligible later round receives a permit; remaining initial rounds may overlap and retain their three-agent limit; all active rounds count toward four; preserve original dependencies; not formal runtime round closure
concurrency_amendment.effective_capacity: minimum of applicable Owner ceiling, actual host capacity, ready dependency checkpoints and disjoint complete wave locks; do not manufacture concurrency

checkpoint_acceptance.routine: coordinator verifies exact HEAD/tree/base/diff/prompt, path authority, declared evidence and distinct review then records accepted-under-standing-Owner-mandate
checkpoint_acceptance.inspector_red: retained reproducible counterexamples may permit only the declared Engineer handoff; never a passing final gate
checkpoint_acceptance.failed_or_unknown: retain and resolve; no auto-PASS, invented human actor, hidden failure or synthesized observation
checkpoint_acceptance.historical: original receipts, prompts, model maps and digests remain immutable; new plan hashes apply only to newly initiated/reopened work

CMP-0006.integration_responsibility: central campaign coordinator alone updates cumulative integration candidate and campaign-wide planning/manifest files; round coordinators own local contributions and request scoped amendments; serialized PR-A then PR-B discipline retained
CMP-0006.effect_execution: standing Owner mandate authorizes necessary declared CMP-0006 effects; bind concrete candidate/version/run/environment/inputs and single-use record before execution; mark performed_at only after observed completion; protected service approval and custody cannot be forged
CMP-0006.external_host_authoring: configured desktop host defaults are approved for external CMP-0006 source authoring only; record actual model/effort separately from immutable declared tier maps; do not claim runtime/live evaluator conformity; product model registry and historical pins unchanged

prompts.preamble: the campaign prompts.preamble file, pasted verbatim first
prompts.task: the task prompt.path file, pasted verbatim second
prompts.self_contained: a task prompt must name its record, discipline, boundary, deliverables, acceptance commands, and commit types without relying on conversation history
prompts.pinning: sha256 of the task prompt file is recorded on the task at start; a change afterwards is drift and requires re-review of the open pull request
prompts.role_declaration: the prompt states exactly one role and the session declares the same role
prompts.model_and_effort: every task prompt states its tier and effort from the tier map, law/policy/model-tiers.json merged with the campaign models override; the host model behind a tier is resolved from the map pinned on the task, never named in the prompt
prompts.time_bound: every prompt states that time matters: deliver the declared scope within the time budget, report partial progress rather than pursue perfection, and never widen scope to chase an unrelated improvement

commits.grammar: type(scope): subject as declared by the campaign task commit_types until law/policy/commit-grammar.json exists, then that policy
commits.attribution: the session tool's attribution trailer is kept
commits.no_version_bump: a campaign task never edits a package version, except a release rollover task the campaign declares for that purpose

failure.acceptance_failure: the task stays in_progress; the report names the failing command and output
failure.extrinsic_failure: an environment or credential failure is reported as blocked-environment, never as an acceptance failure
failure.gap: a missing or contradictory contract moves the task to blocked with the exact question; the responsible role answers in its own session
failure.dependent_after_failure: a downstream task never starts on a failed or blocked upstream
failure.rollback: as law/policy/round-execution.json rollback: unmerged branches are abandoned, merged work is reverted by a new authorized commit
failure.escalation: after one failed iteration or a blocked report the orchestrator re-runs the task one tier rank up the map pinned on the task, up to its ceiling; a second failure at the ceiling is a gap for a human

evidence.acceptance_output: summarized in the pull request description; raw output is not committed
evidence.campaign_ledger: the campaign document is updated by the maintainer after each merge and each close; it is committed as plan class

mapping.title: task.title
mapping.executor: kind human with role equal to discipline and instructions_ref equal to the prompt path

materialization.when: optional; a campaign may run entirely as human-driven pull requests without materialization
materialization.self_dogfood: when constraints.self_dogfood is true, materialization is limited to what law/policy/self-dogfood.json permits and never dispatches an executor
